mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT lambda_assignment_id, lane, run_id FROM lambda_run_completion_outbox WHERE claim_until IS NULL OR claim_until <= #{now} ORDER BY created_at, lambda_assignment_id, lane, run_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE lambda_run_completion_outbox o SET claim_id = #{claimId,typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.UuidStringTypeHandler}, claim_until = #{claimUntil} FROM candidate c WHERE o.lambda_assignment_id = c.lambda_assignment_id AND o.lane = c.lane AND o.run_id = c.run_id RETURNING o.lambda_assignment_id, o.lane, o.run_id, o.created_at, CAST(o.claim_id AS VARCHAR) AS claim_id, o.claim_until
